## gcc/ada/exp_ch6.adb:6224–6290

```text
6224:       procedure Add_Return (Spec_Id : Entity_Id; Stmts : List_Id) is
6225:          Last_Stmt : Node_Id;
6226:          Loc       : Source_Ptr;
6227:          Stmt      : Node_Id;
6228:
6229:       begin
6230:          --  Get last statement, ignoring any Pop_xxx_Label nodes, which are
6231:          --  not relevant in this context since they are not executable.
6232:
6233:          Last_Stmt := Last (Stmts);
6234:          while Nkind (Last_Stmt) in N_Pop_xxx_Label loop
6235:             Prev (Last_Stmt);
6236:          end loop;
6237:
6238:          --  Now insert return unless last statement is a transfer
6239:
6240:          if not Is_Transfer (Last_Stmt) then
6241:
6242:             --  The source location for the return is the end label of the
6243:             --  procedure if present. Otherwise use the sloc of the last
6244:             --  statement in the list. If the list comes from a generated
6245:             --  exception handler and we are not debugging generated code,
6246:             --  all the statements within the handler are made invisible
6247:             --  to the debugger.
6248:
6249:             if Nkind (Parent (Stmts)) = N_Exception_Handler
6250:               and then not Comes_From_Source (Parent (Stmts))
6251:             then
6252:                Loc := Sloc (Last_Stmt);
6253:             elsif Present (End_Label (HSS)) then
6254:                Loc := Sloc (End_Label (HSS));
6255:             else
6256:                Loc := Sloc (Last_Stmt);
6257:             end if;
6258:
6259:             --  Append return statement, and set analyzed manually. We can't
6260:             --  call Analyze on this return since the scope is wrong.
6261:
6262:             --  Note: it almost works to push the scope and then do the Analyze
6263:             --  call, but something goes wrong in some weird cases and it is
6264:             --  not worth worrying about ???
6265:
6266:             Stmt := Make_Simple_Return_Statement (Loc);
6267:
6268:             --  The return statement is handled properly, and the call to the
6269:             --  postcondition, inserted below, does not require information
6270:             --  from the body either. However, that call is analyzed in the
6271:             --  enclosing scope, and an elaboration check might improperly be
6272:             --  added to it. A guard in Sem_Elab is needed to prevent that
6273:             --  spurious check, see Check_Elab_Call.
6274:
6275:             Append_To (Stmts, Stmt);
6276:             Set_Analyzed (Stmt);
6277:
6278:             --  Ada 2022 (AI12-0279): append the call to 'Yield unless this is
6279:             --  a generic subprogram (since in such case it will be added to
6280:             --  the instantiations).
6281:
6282:             if Has_Yield_Aspect (Spec_Id)
6283:               and then Ekind (Spec_Id) /= E_Generic_Procedure
6284:               and then RTE_Available (RE_Yield)
6285:             then
6286:                Insert_Action (Stmt,
6287:                  Make_Procedure_Call_Statement (Loc,
6288:                    New_Occurrence_Of (RTE (RE_Yield), Loc)));
6289:             end if;
6290:          end if;
```

```text
43:    procedure Image_Integer
44:      (V : Integer;
45:       S : in out String;
46:       P : out Natural)
47:      renames Impl.Image_Integer;
48:    --  Computes Integer'Image (``V``) and stores the result in
49:    --  ``S`` (1 .. ``P``) setting the resulting value of ``P``.
50:    --  The caller guarantees that ``S`` is long enough to hold the result,
51:    --  and that ``S``'First is 1.
52:    --
53:    --  If ``V`` is not negative, the subprogram writes the leading blank in
54:    --  ``S``. It then calls *Set_Image_Integer* unconditionally.
55:
56:    procedure Set_Image_Integer
57:      (V : Integer;
58:       S : in out String;
59:       P : in out Natural)
60:      renames Impl.Set_Image_Integer;
61:    --  Stores the image of ``V`` in ``S`` starting at ``S`` (``P`` + 1), ``P``
62:    --  is updated to point to the last character stored. The value stored is
63:    --  identical to the value of Integer'Image (``V``) except that no leading
64:    --  space is stored when ``V`` is non-negative. The caller guarantees that
65:    --  ``S`` is long enough to hold the result. ``S`` need not have a lower
66:    --  bound of 1.
67:    --
68:    --  If ``V`` is negative, the subprogram writes the leading '-' character,
69:    --  otherwise work with -``V`` (always work with negative value to avoid
70:    --  overflow: the largest negative number is not a special case).
71:    --
72:    --  This subprogram then uses recursion: if the value is equal or less than
73:    --  -10, recurse with the value divided by 10. Then add the digit for the
74:    --  remainder.
75:
76: end System.Img_Int;
```

```text
34:
35: package System.Concat_8 is
36:
37:    procedure Str_Concat_8
38:      (R                              : out String;
39:       S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S8 : String);
40:    --  Performs the operation R := S1 & S2 & S3 & S4 & S5 & S6 & S7 & S8.
41:    --  The bounds of R are known to be sufficient so no bound checks are
42:    --  required and it is known that none of the input operands overlaps R. No
43:    --  assumptions can be made about the lower bounds of any of the operands.
44:
45: end System.Concat_8;
```

```text
5131:
5132:       /* Start from the real object and build the actual.  */

5172:       /* If the formal parameter is passed by reference, check that building

5509:             get_atomic_access (gnat_actual, &aa_type, &aa_sync);

5511:             /* If an outer atomic access is required for an actual parameter,

5536:   /* If this is a function call, the result is the call expression unless a
5537:      target is specified, in which case we copy the result into the target

5542:          return value from it and update the return type.  */

5552:          the pointer.  */

5561:           gigi_checking_assert (!Do_Range_Check (gnat_node));

5563:           /* If the parent is an initialization statement, we can use the
5564:              return slot optimization.  */

5571:              slot optimization as we would not be able to create a temporary.

5574:             op_code = INIT_EXPR;

5576:           /* If this is a call to a pure function returning an array of scalar
5577:              type, try to apply the return slot optimization.  */

5579:                     || TYPE_RESTRICT (gnu_subprog_type))

5582:                    && aggregate_value_p (gnu_result_type, gnu_subprog_type)

5598:           /* Use the required method to move the result to the target.  */

5661:
5662: /* Subroutine of gnat_to_gnu to translate GNAT_NODE, an
5663:    N_Handled_Sequence_Of_Statements, to a GCC tree, which is returned.  */
5664:
5665: static tree
5666: Handled_Sequence_Of_Statements_to_gnu (Node_Id gnat_node)
5667: {
5668:   /* If just annotating, ignore all EH and cleanups.  */
5669:   const bool eh
5670:     = !type_annotate_only && Present (Exception_Handlers (gnat_node));
5671:   const bool at_end = !type_annotate_only && Present (At_End_Proc (gnat_node));
5672:   tree gnu_result;
5673:   Node_Id gnat_temp;
5674:
5675:   /* The exception handling mechanism can handle both ZCX and SJLJ schemes, and
5676:      is exposed through the TRY_CATCH_EXPR construct that we build manually.
5677:
5678:      ??? The region level calls down there have been specifically put in place
5679:      for a ZCX context and currently the order in which things are emitted
5680:      (region/handlers) is different from the SJLJ case.  Instead of putting
5681:      other calls with different conditions at other places for the SJLJ case,
5682:      it seems cleaner to reorder things for the SJLJ case and generalize the
5683:      condition to make it not ZCX specific.  */
5684:
5685:   /* First build the tree for the statements inside the sequence.  */
5686:   start_stmt_group ();
5687:
5688:   for (gnat_temp = First (Statements (gnat_node));
5689:        Present (gnat_temp);
5690:        gnat_temp = Next (gnat_temp))
5691:     add_stmt (gnat_to_gnu (gnat_temp));
5692:
5693:   gnu_result = end_stmt_group ();
5694:
5695:   /* Then process the exception handlers, if any.  */
5696:   if (eh)
5697:     {
5698:       tree gnu_handlers;
5699:       location_t locus;
5700:
5701:       /* First make a group containing the handlers.  */
5702:       start_stmt_group ();
5703:       for (gnat_temp = First_Non_Pragma (Exception_Handlers (gnat_node));
5704:            Present (gnat_temp);
5705:            gnat_temp = Next_Non_Pragma (gnat_temp))
5706:         add_stmt (gnat_to_gnu (gnat_temp));
5707:       gnu_handlers = end_stmt_group ();
5708:
5709:       /* Now make the TRY_CATCH_EXPR for the group.  */
5710:       gnu_result
5711:         = build2 (TRY_CATCH_EXPR, void_type_node, gnu_result, gnu_handlers);
5712:
5713:       /* Set a location.  We need to find a unique location for the dispatching
5714:          code, otherwise we can get coverage or debugging issues.  Try with
5715:          the location of the end label.  */
5716:       if (Present (End_Label (gnat_node))
5717:           && Sloc_to_locus (Sloc (End_Label (gnat_node)), &locus))
5718:         SET_EXPR_LOCATION (gnu_result, locus);
5719:       else
5720:         /* Clear column information so that the exception handler of an
5721:            implicit transient block does not incorrectly inherit the slocs
5722:            of a decision, which would otherwise confuse control flow based
5723:            coverage analysis tools.  */
5724:         set_expr_location_from_node (gnu_result, gnat_node, true);
5725:     }
5726:
5727:   if (Present (Finally_Statements (gnat_node)))
5728:     {
5729:       tree finally_stmts;
5730:       location_t locus;
5731:
5732:       start_stmt_group ();
5733:       for (gnat_temp = First_Non_Pragma (Finally_Statements (gnat_node));
5734:            Present (gnat_temp);
5735:            gnat_temp = Next_Non_Pragma (gnat_temp))
5736:         add_stmt (gnat_to_gnu (gnat_temp));
5737:       finally_stmts = end_stmt_group ();
5738:
5739:       gnu_result
5740:         = build2 (TRY_FINALLY_EXPR, void_type_node, gnu_result, finally_stmts);
5741:
5742:       /* Do as above for the TRY_CATCH_EXPR case.  */
5743:       if (Present (End_Label (gnat_node))
5744:           && Sloc_to_locus (Sloc (End_Label (gnat_node)), &locus))
5745:         SET_EXPR_LOCATION (gnu_result, locus);
5746:       else
5747:         set_expr_location_from_node (gnu_result, gnat_node, true);
5748:     }
5749:
5750:   /* Process the At_End_Proc, if any.  */
5751:   if (at_end)
5752:     {
5753:       start_stmt_group ();
5754:       add_stmt (gnu_result);
5755:       At_End_Proc_to_gnu (gnat_node);
5756:       gnu_result = end_stmt_group ();
5757:     }
5758:
```

```text
6118: Range_to_gnu (Node_Id gnat_range, tree *gnu_low, tree *gnu_high)

6138:       }
6139:       break;

6143:     }
```

```text
4402: {

4412:   if (TREE_CODE (array_type) == ARRAY_TYPE
4413:       || (TREE_CODE (array_type) == INTEGER_TYPE
4414:           && TYPE_HAS_ACTUAL_BOUNDS_P (array_type)))

4417:   /* First make the list for a CONSTRUCTOR for the template.  Go down
4418:      the field list of the template instead of the type chain because
4419:      this array might be an Ada array of array and we can't tell where
4420:      the nested array stop being the underlying object.  */
4421:   for (field = TYPE_FIELDS (template_type);
4422:        field;
4423:        field = DECL_CHAIN (DECL_CHAIN (field)))

4430:          template, but this will only give us a maximum range.  */
4431:       if (bound_list)
4432:         {
4433:           bounds = TREE_VALUE (bound_list);
4434:           bound_list = TREE_CHAIN (bound_list);

4436:       else if (TREE_CODE (array_type) == ARRAY_TYPE)

4439:           array_type = TREE_TYPE (array_type);
4440:         }
4441:       else if (expr && TREE_CODE (expr) == PARM_DECL

4443:         bounds = TREE_TYPE (field);

4445:         gcc_unreachable ();

4447:       min = convert (TREE_TYPE (field), TYPE_MIN_VALUE (bounds));
4448:       max = convert (TREE_TYPE (DECL_CHAIN (field)), TYPE_MAX_VALUE (bounds));

4452:       min = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (min, expr);
```

```text
5764: maybe_unconstrained_array (tree exp)
5765: {
5766:   enum tree_code code = TREE_CODE (exp);
5767:   tree type = TREE_TYPE (exp);
5768:
5769:   switch (TREE_CODE (type))
5770:     {
5771:     case UNCONSTRAINED_ARRAY_TYPE:
5772:       if (code == UNCONSTRAINED_ARRAY_REF)
5773:         {
5774:           const bool read_only = TREE_READONLY (exp);
5775:           const bool no_trap = TREE_THIS_NOTRAP (exp);
5776:
5777:           exp = TREE_OPERAND (exp, 0);
5778:           type = TREE_TYPE (exp);
5779:
5780:           if (TREE_CODE (exp) == COND_EXPR)
5781:             {
5782:               tree op1
5783:                 = build_unary_op (INDIRECT_REF, NULL_TREE,
5784:                                   build_component_ref (TREE_OPERAND (exp, 1),
5785:                                                        TYPE_FIELDS (type),
5786:                                                        false));
5787:               tree op2
5788:                 = build_unary_op (INDIRECT_REF, NULL_TREE,
5789:                                   build_component_ref (TREE_OPERAND (exp, 2),
5790:                                                        TYPE_FIELDS (type),
5791:                                                        false));
5792:
5793:               exp = build3 (COND_EXPR,
5794:                             TREE_TYPE (TREE_TYPE (TYPE_FIELDS (type))),
5795:                             TREE_OPERAND (exp, 0), op1, op2);
5796:             }
5797:           else
5798:             {
5799:               exp = build_unary_op (INDIRECT_REF, NULL_TREE,
5800:                                     build_component_ref (exp,
5801:                                                          TYPE_FIELDS (type),
5802:                                                          false));
5803:               TREE_READONLY (exp) = read_only;
5804:               TREE_THIS_NOTRAP (exp) = no_trap;
5805:             }
5806:         }
5807:
5808:       else if (code == LOAD_EXPR)
5809:         {
5810:           const Entity_Id gnat_smo = tree_to_shwi (TREE_OPERAND (exp, 1));
5811:           tree t = maybe_unconstrained_array (TREE_OPERAND (exp, 0));
5812:           exp = build_storage_model_load (gnat_smo, t);
5813:         }
5814:
5815:       else if (code == NULL_EXPR)
5816:         exp = build1 (NULL_EXPR,
5817:                       TREE_TYPE (TREE_TYPE (TYPE_FIELDS (TREE_TYPE (type)))),

5819:       break;
5820:

5823:          unpadded type first.  */
5824:       if (TYPE_PADDING_P (type)

5826:           && TYPE_CONTAINS_TEMPLATE_P (TREE_TYPE (TYPE_FIELDS (type))))

5830:           type = TREE_TYPE (exp);
```

```text
4950:
4951:                    superset      superset
4952:                 R ----------> D ----------> T
4953:
4954:          However, for composite types, conversions between derived types are
4955:          translated into VIEW_CONVERT_EXPRs so a sequence like:
4956:
4957:             type Comp1 is new Comp;
4958:             type Comp2 is new Comp;
4959:             procedure Proc (C : Comp1);
4960:
4961:             C : Comp2;
4962:             Proc (Comp1 (C));
4963:
4964:          is translated into:
4965:
4966:             C : Comp2;
4967:             Proc ((Comp1 &) &VIEW_CONVERT_EXPR <Comp1> (C));
4968:
4969:          and gimplified into:
4970:
4971:             C : Comp2;
4972:             Comp1 *C.0;
4973:             C.0 = (Comp1 *) &C;
4974:             Proc (C.0);
4975:
4976:          i.e. generates code involving type punning.  Therefore, Comp1 needs
4977:          to conflict with Comp2 and an alias set copy is required.
4978:
4979:          The language rules ensure the parent type is already frozen here.  */
4980:       if (kind != E_Subprogram_Type
4981:           && Is_Derived_Type (gnat_entity)
4982:           && !type_annotate_only)
4983:         {
4984:           Entity_Id gnat_parent_type = Underlying_Type (Etype (gnat_entity));
4985:           /* For constrained packed array subtypes, the implementation type is
4986:              used instead of the nominal type.  */
4987:           if (kind == E_Array_Subtype
4988:               && Is_Constrained (gnat_entity)
4989:               && Present (Packed_Array_Impl_Type (gnat_parent_type)))
4990:             gnat_parent_type = Packed_Array_Impl_Type (gnat_parent_type);
4991:           relate_alias_sets (gnu_type, gnat_to_gnu_type (gnat_parent_type),
4992:                              Is_Composite_Type (gnat_entity)
4993:                              ? ALIAS_SET_COPY : ALIAS_SET_SUPERSET);
4994:         }
4995:
4996:       /* Finally get to the appropriate variant, except for the implementation
4997:          type of a packed array because the GNU type might be further adjusted
4998:          when the original array type is itself processed.  */
4999:       if (Treat_As_Volatile (gnat_entity)
5000:           && !Is_Packed_Array_Impl_Type (gnat_entity))
5001:         {
5002:           const int quals
5003:             = TYPE_QUAL_VOLATILE
5004:               | (Is_Full_Access (gnat_entity) ? TYPE_QUAL_ATOMIC : 0);
5005:           /* This is required by free_lang_data_in_type to disable the ODR.  */
5006:           if (TREE_CODE (gnu_type) == ENUMERAL_TYPE)
5007:             TYPE_STUB_DECL (gnu_type)
5008:               = create_type_stub_decl (TYPE_NAME (gnu_type), gnu_type);
5009:           gnu_type = change_qualified_type (gnu_type, quals);
5010:         }
5011:
5012:       /* If we already made a decl, just set the type, otherwise create it.  */
5013:       if (gnu_decl)
5014:         {
5015:           TREE_TYPE (gnu_decl) = gnu_type;
5016:           TYPE_STUB_DECL (gnu_type) = gnu_decl;
5017:         }
5018:       else
5019:         gnu_decl = create_type_decl (gnu_entity_name, gnu_type, artificial_p,
5020:                                      debug_info_p, gnat_entity);
5021:     }
5022:
5023:   /* If we haven't already, associate the ..._DECL node that we just made with
5024:      the input GNAT entity node.  */
5025:   if (!saved)
5026:     save_gnu_tree (gnat_entity, gnu_decl, false);
```

```text
7532: elaborate_expression (Node_Id gnat_expr, Entity_Id gnat_entity, const char *s,
7533:                       bool definition, bool need_value, bool need_for_debug)
7534: {
7535:   tree gnu_expr;
7536:
7537:   /* If we already elaborated this expression (e.g. it was involved
7538:      in the definition of a private type), use the old value.  */

7543:      we don't need to do anything.  */
7544:   if (!need_value
7545:       && (Compile_Time_Known_Value (gnat_expr)
7546:           || (Nkind (gnat_expr) == N_Identifier
7547:               && Ekind (Entity (gnat_expr)) == E_Discriminant)))
7548:     return NULL_TREE;
7549:
7550:   /* If it's a static expression, we don't need a variable for debugging.  */
7551:   if (need_for_debug && Compile_Time_Known_Value (gnat_expr))
7552:     need_for_debug = false;
7553:
7554:   /* Otherwise, convert this tree to its GCC equivalent and elaborate it.  */
7555:   gnu_expr = elaborate_expression_1 (gnat_to_gnu (gnat_expr), gnat_entity, s,
7556:                                      definition, need_for_debug);
7557:
7558:   /* Save the expression in case we try to elaborate this entity again.  Since
7559:      it's not a DECL, don't check it.  Don't save if it's a discriminant.  */
7560:   if (!CONTAINS_PLACEHOLDER_P (gnu_expr))
7561:     save_gnu_tree (gnat_expr, gnu_expr, true);
7562:
7563:   return need_value ? gnu_expr : error_mark_node;
7564: }

7576:      that an expression cannot contain both a discriminant and a variable.  */

7578:     return gnu_expr;
7579:

7581:      a variable that is initialized to contain the expression when the package
7582:      containing the definition is elaborated.  If this entity is defined at top
7583:      level, replace the expression by the variable; otherwise use a SAVE_EXPR
7584:      if this is necessary.  */
7585:   if (TREE_CONSTANT (gnu_expr))

7587:   else
7588:     {

7590:          expression is based on a read-only variable.  */
7591:       tree inner = remove_conversions (gnu_expr, true);
7592:
7593:       inner = skip_simple_constant_arithmetic (inner);

7595:       if (handled_component_p (inner))

7620:       && gnat_encodings != DWARF_GNAT_ENCODINGS_ALL
7621:       && (TREE_CONSTANT (gnu_expr)
7622:           || (!Is_Public (gnat_entity)
7623:               && DECL_P (gnu_expr)

7633:          new variable must not be tagged "external", as we used to do here as

7635:          here instead of NEED_FOR_DEBUG because, once the variable is created,
```

```text
256:      we did, the non-BLKmode type could not have been used.  */

262:      this point it is known to be smaller, or of constant size and the
263:      lhs type is not.  */
264:   if (TREE_CONSTANT (TYPE_SIZE (t2)))

268:   if (TYPE_MODE (t2) != BLKmode)

272:      probably best to leave the "type mismatch" because changing it

277: /* Return an expression tree representing an equality comparison of A1 and A2,
278:    two objects of type ARRAY_TYPE.  The result should be of type RESULT_TYPE.
279:
280:    Two arrays are equal in one of two ways: (1) if both have zero length in
281:    some dimension (not necessarily the same dimension) or (2) if the lengths
282:    in each dimension are equal and the data is equal.  We perform the length
283:    tests in as efficient a manner as possible.  */

285: static tree
286: compare_arrays_for_equality (location_t loc, tree result_type, tree a1, tree a2)
287: {
288:   tree result = convert (result_type, boolean_true_node);
289:   tree a1_is_null = convert (result_type, boolean_false_node);
290:   tree a2_is_null = convert (result_type, boolean_false_node);
291:   tree t1 = TREE_TYPE (a1);
292:   tree t2 = TREE_TYPE (a2);
293:   bool a1_side_effects_p = TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (a1);
294:   bool a2_side_effects_p = TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (a2);

305:   /* Process each dimension separately and compare the lengths.  If any
306:      dimension has a length known to be zero, set LENGTH_ZERO_P to true

308:   while (TREE_CODE (t1) == ARRAY_TYPE && TREE_CODE (t2) == ARRAY_TYPE)
309:     {
310:       tree dom1 = TYPE_DOMAIN (t1);
311:       tree dom2 = TYPE_DOMAIN (t2);
312:       tree length1 = size_binop (PLUS_EXPR,
313:                                  size_binop (MINUS_EXPR,
314:                                              TYPE_MAX_VALUE (dom1),
315:                                              TYPE_MIN_VALUE (dom1)),
316:                                  size_one_node);
317:       tree length2 = size_binop (PLUS_EXPR,
318:                                  size_binop (MINUS_EXPR,
319:                                              TYPE_MAX_VALUE (dom2),
320:                                              TYPE_MIN_VALUE (dom2)),
321:                                  size_one_node);

323:       tree ind2 = TYPE_INDEX_TYPE (dom2);

326:       tree ub1 = convert (base_type, TYPE_MAX_VALUE (ind1));
327:       tree lb2 = convert (base_type, TYPE_MIN_VALUE (ind2));
328:       tree ub2 = convert (base_type, TYPE_MAX_VALUE (ind2));

331:       /* If the length of the first array is a constant and that of the second
332:          array is not, swap our operands to have the constant second.  */
333:       if (TREE_CODE (length1) == INTEGER_CST
334:           && TREE_CODE (length2) != INTEGER_CST)
335:         {
336:           tree tem;
337:           bool btem;
338:
339:           tem = a1, a1 = a2, a2 = tem;
340:           tem = t1, t1 = t2, t2 = tem;
341:           tem = lb1, lb1 = lb2, lb2 = tem;
342:           tem = ub1, ub1 = ub2, ub2 = tem;
343:           tem = length1, length1 = length2, length2 = tem;
344:           tem = a1_is_null, a1_is_null = a2_is_null, a2_is_null = tem;
345:           btem = a1_side_effects_p, a1_side_effects_p = a2_side_effects_p,
346:           a2_side_effects_p = btem;
347:         }
348:
349:       /* If the length of the second array is the constant zero, we can just
350:          use the original stored bounds for the first array and see whether
351:          last < first holds.  */
352:       if (integer_zerop (length2))
353:         {
354:           length_zero_p = true;
355:
356:           lb1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (lb1, a1);
357:           ub1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (ub1, a1);
358:
359:           comparison = fold_build2_loc (loc, LT_EXPR, result_type, ub1, lb1);
360:
361:           this_a1_is_null = comparison;
362:           this_a2_is_null = convert (result_type, boolean_true_node);
363:         }
364:
365:       /* Otherwise, if the length is some other constant value, we know that
366:          this dimension in the second array cannot be superflat, so we can
367:          just use its length computed from the actual stored bounds.  */
368:       else if (TREE_CODE (length2) == INTEGER_CST)
369:         {
370:           /* Note that we know that LB2 and UB2 are constant and hence
371:              cannot contain a PLACEHOLDER_EXPR.  */
372:           lb1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (lb1, a1);
373:           ub1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (ub1, a1);
374:
375:           comparison
376:             = fold_build2_loc (loc, EQ_EXPR, result_type,
377:                                build_binary_op (MINUS_EXPR, base_type,
378:                                                 ub1, lb1),
379:                                build_binary_op (MINUS_EXPR, base_type,
380:                                                 ub2, lb2));
381:           this_a1_is_null
382:             = fold_build2_loc (loc, LT_EXPR, result_type, ub1, lb1);
383:
384:           this_a2_is_null = convert (result_type, boolean_false_node);
385:         }
386:
387:       /* Otherwise, compare the computed lengths.  */
388:       else
389:         {
390:           length1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (length1, a1);
391:           length2 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (length2, a2);
392:
393:           comparison
394:             = fold_build2_loc (loc, EQ_EXPR, result_type, length1, length2);
395:
396:           lb1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (lb1, a1);
397:           ub1 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (ub1, a1);
398:
399:           this_a1_is_null
400:             = fold_build2_loc (loc, LT_EXPR, result_type, ub1, lb1);
401:
402:           lb2 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (lb2, a2);
403:           ub2 = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (ub2, a2);
404:
405:           this_a2_is_null
406:             = fold_build2_loc (loc, LT_EXPR, result_type, ub2, lb2);
407:         }
408:
409:       /* Append expressions for this dimension to the final expressions.  */
410:       result = build_binary_op (TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR, result_type,
411:                                 result, comparison);
412:
413:       a1_is_null = build_binary_op (TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR, result_type,
414:                                     this_a1_is_null, a1_is_null);
415:
416:       a2_is_null = build_binary_op (TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR, result_type,
417:                                     this_a2_is_null, a2_is_null);
418:
419:       t1 = TREE_TYPE (t1);
420:       t2 = TREE_TYPE (t2);
421:     }
422:
423:   /* Unless the length of some dimension is known to be zero, compare the
424:      data in the array.  */
425:   if (!length_zero_p)
426:     {
427:       tree type = find_common_type (TREE_TYPE (a1), TREE_TYPE (a2));
428:       tree comparison;
429:
430:       if (type)
431:         {
432:           a1 = convert (type, a1),
433:           a2 = convert (type, a2);
434:         }
435:
436:       comparison = fold_build2_loc (loc, EQ_EXPR, result_type, a1, a2);
437:
438:       result
439:         = build_binary_op (TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR, result_type, result, comparison);
440:     }
441:
442:   /* The result is also true if both sizes are zero.  */
443:   result = build_binary_op (TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR, result_type,
444:                             build_binary_op (TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR, result_type,
445:                                              a1_is_null, a2_is_null),
446:                             result);
447:
448:   /* If the operands have side-effects, they need to be evaluated before
449:      doing the tests above since the place they otherwise would end up
450:      being evaluated at run time could be wrong.  */
451:   if (a1_side_effects_p)
452:     result = build2 (COMPOUND_EXPR, result_type, a1, result);
453:
454:   if (a2_side_effects_p)
455:     result = build2 (COMPOUND_EXPR, result_type, a2, result);
```

```text
127:   gimple_stmt_iterator i;

131:   /* The gimplifier should've left a body of exactly one statement,

135:
136:   memset (&data, 0, sizeof (data));
137:   data.block = DECL_INITIAL (current_function_decl);
138:   BLOCK_SUBBLOCKS (data.block) = NULL_TREE;
139:   BLOCK_CHAIN (data.block) = NULL_TREE;
140:   TREE_ASM_WRITTEN (data.block) = 1;
141:   data.return_statements.create (8);
142:
143:   bind = gimple_seq_first_stmt (body);
144:   lowered_body = NULL;
145:   gimple_seq_add_stmt (&lowered_body, bind);
146:   i = gsi_start (lowered_body);
147:   lower_gimple_bind (&i, &data);
148:
149:   i = gsi_last (lowered_body);
150:
151:   /* If we had begin stmt markers from e.g. PCH, but this compilation
152:      doesn't want them, lower_stmt will have cleaned them up; we can
153:      now clear the flag that indicates we had them.  */
154:   if (!MAY_HAVE_DEBUG_MARKER_STMTS && cfun->debug_nonbind_markers)
155:     {
156:       /* This counter needs not be exact, but before lowering it will
157:          most certainly be.  */
158:       gcc_assert (cfun->debug_marker_count == 0);
159:       cfun->debug_nonbind_markers = false;
160:     }
161:
162:   /* If the function falls off the end, we need a null return statement.
163:      If we've already got one in the return_statements vector, we don't
164:      need to do anything special.  Otherwise build one by hand.  */
165:   bool may_fallthru = gimple_seq_may_fallthru (lowered_body);
166:   if (may_fallthru
167:       && (data.return_statements.is_empty ()
168:           || (gimple_return_retval (data.return_statements.last().stmt)
169:               != NULL)))
170:     {
171:       x = gimple_build_return (NULL);
172:       gimple_set_location (x, cfun->function_end_locus);
173:       gimple_set_block (x, DECL_INITIAL (current_function_decl));
174:       gsi_insert_after (&i, x, GSI_CONTINUE_LINKING);
175:       may_fallthru = false;
176:     }
177:
178:   /* If we lowered any return statements, emit the representative
179:      at the end of the function.  */
180:   while (!data.return_statements.is_empty ())
181:     {
182:       return_statements_t t = data.return_statements.pop ();
183:       x = gimple_build_label (t.label);
184:       gsi_insert_after (&i, x, GSI_CONTINUE_LINKING);
185:       gsi_insert_after (&i, t.stmt, GSI_CONTINUE_LINKING);
186:       if (may_fallthru)
187:         {
188:           /* Remove the line number from the representative return statement.
189:              It now fills in for the fallthru too.  Failure to remove this
190:              will result in incorrect results for coverage analysis.  */
191:           gimple_set_location (t.stmt, UNKNOWN_LOCATION);
192:           may_fallthru = false;
193:         }
194:     }
195:
196:   /* Once the old body has been lowered, replace it with the new
197:      lowered sequence.  */
198:   gimple_set_body (current_function_decl, lowered_body);
199:
200:   if (assume_labels)
201:     {
202:       struct walk_stmt_info wi;
203:
204:       memset (&wi, 0, sizeof (wi));
205:       walk_gimple_seq (lowered_body, NULL, diagnose_assume_labels, &wi);
206:       BITMAP_FREE (assume_labels);
207:     }

209:   gcc_assert (data.block == DECL_INITIAL (current_function_decl));
```

```text
695:    statements in order to prevent the EH lowering pass from adding useless

700: static void
701: lower_stmt (gimple_stmt_iterator *gsi, struct lower_data *data)
702: {
703:   gimple *stmt = gsi_stmt (*gsi);
704:
705:   gimple_set_block (stmt, data->block);
706:
707:   switch (gimple_code (stmt))
708:     {
709:     case GIMPLE_BIND:
710:       lower_gimple_bind (gsi, data);
711:       /* Propagate fallthruness.  */
712:       return;
713:
714:     case GIMPLE_COND:
715:     case GIMPLE_GOTO:
716:     case GIMPLE_SWITCH:
717:       data->cannot_fallthru = true;
718:       gsi_next (gsi);
719:       return;
720:
721:     case GIMPLE_RETURN:
722:       if (data->cannot_fallthru)
723:         {
724:           gsi_remove (gsi, false);
725:           /* Propagate fallthruness.  */
726:         }
727:       else
728:         {
729:           lower_gimple_return (gsi, data);
730:           data->cannot_fallthru = true;
731:         }
732:       return;
733:
734:     case GIMPLE_TRY:
735:       if (gimple_try_kind (stmt) == GIMPLE_TRY_CATCH)
736:         lower_try_catch (gsi, data);
737:       else
738:         {
739:           /* It must be a GIMPLE_TRY_FINALLY.  */
740:           bool cannot_fallthru;
741:           lower_sequence (gimple_try_eval_ptr (stmt), data);
742:           cannot_fallthru = data->cannot_fallthru;
```

```text
907: static void
908: lower_gimple_bind (gimple_stmt_iterator *gsi, struct lower_data *data)

919:              outermost statement chain of the gimplified function.  So we
920:              may see the outermost block just inside the function.  */
921:           gcc_assert (new_block == DECL_INITIAL (current_function_decl));

928:           TREE_ASM_WRITTEN (new_block) = 1;
929:
930:           /* Block tree may get clobbered by inlining.  Normally this would
931:              be fixed in rest_of_decl_compilation using block notes, but
932:              since we are not going to emit them, it is up to us.  */
933:           BLOCK_CHAIN (new_block) = BLOCK_SUBBLOCKS (old_block);
934:           BLOCK_SUBBLOCKS (old_block) = new_block;
935:           BLOCK_SUBBLOCKS (new_block) = NULL_TREE;
936:           BLOCK_SUPERCONTEXT (new_block) = old_block;
937:
938:           data->block = new_block;

940:     }

942:   record_vars (gimple_bind_vars (stmt));

945:      need gimple_bind_vars.  */
946:   tree next;
947:   /* BLOCK_VARS and gimple_bind_vars share a common sub-chain.  Find
948:      it by marking all BLOCK_VARS.  */
949:   if (gimple_bind_block (stmt))

954:     {

957:     }
958:   /* Unmark BLOCK_VARS.  */
```

```text
5189:       || TREE_CODE (pred) == TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5190:     {
5191:       tree fst = TREE_OPERAND (pred, 0);
5192:       tree lst = TREE_OPERAND (pred, 1);
5193:
5194:       if (TREE_CODE (fst) == TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR
5195:           || TREE_CODE (fst) == TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5196:         tag_shortcut_cond (fst, condition_uid);
5197:       else if (TREE_CODE (fst) == COND_EXPR)
5198:         tree_associate_condition_with_expr (fst, condition_uid);
5199:
5200:       if (TREE_CODE (lst) == TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR
5201:           || TREE_CODE (lst) == TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5202:         tag_shortcut_cond (lst, condition_uid);
5203:       else if (TREE_CODE (lst) == COND_EXPR)
5204:         tree_associate_condition_with_expr (lst, condition_uid);
5205:     }
5206: }
5207:
5208: /* Given a conditional expression EXPR with short-circuit boolean
5209:    predicates using TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR or TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR, break the
5210:    predicate apart into the equivalent sequence of conditionals.  CONDITION_UID
5211:    is a the tag/discriminator for this EXPR - all basic conditions in the
5212:    expression will be given the same CONDITION_UID.  */
5213: static tree
5214: shortcut_cond_expr (tree expr, unsigned condition_uid)
5215: {
5216:   tree pred = TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0);
5217:   tree then_ = TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1);
5218:   tree else_ = TREE_OPERAND (expr, 2);
5219:   tree true_label, false_label, end_label, t;
5220:   tree *true_label_p;
5221:   tree *false_label_p;
5222:   bool emit_end, emit_false, jump_over_else;
5223:   bool then_se = then_ && TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (then_);
5224:   bool else_se = else_ && TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (else_);
5225:
5226:   tag_shortcut_cond (pred, condition_uid);
5227:
5228:   /* First do simple transformations.  */
5229:   if (!else_se)
5230:     {
5231:       /* If there is no 'else', turn
5232:            if (a && b) then c
5233:          into
5234:            if (a) if (b) then c.  */
5235:       while (TREE_CODE (pred) == TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR)
5236:         {
5237:           /* Keep the original source location on the first 'if'.  */
5238:           location_t locus = EXPR_LOC_OR_LOC (expr, input_location);
5239:           TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0) = TREE_OPERAND (pred, 1);
5240:           /* Set the source location of the && on the second 'if'.  */
5241:           if (rexpr_has_location (pred))
5242:             SET_EXPR_LOCATION (expr, rexpr_location (pred));
5243:           then_ = shortcut_cond_expr (expr, condition_uid);
5244:           then_se = then_ && TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (then_);
5245:           pred = TREE_OPERAND (pred, 0);
5246:           expr = build3 (COND_EXPR, void_type_node, pred, then_, NULL_TREE);
5247:           SET_EXPR_LOCATION (expr, locus);
5248:         }
5249:     }
5250:
5251:   if (!then_se)
5252:     {
5253:       /* If there is no 'then', turn
5254:            if (a || b); else d
5255:          into
5256:            if (a); else if (b); else d.  */
5257:       while (TREE_CODE (pred) == TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5258:         {
5259:           /* Keep the original source location on the first 'if'.  */
5260:           location_t locus = EXPR_LOC_OR_LOC (expr, input_location);
5261:           TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0) = TREE_OPERAND (pred, 1);
5262:           /* Set the source location of the || on the second 'if'.  */
5263:           if (rexpr_has_location (pred))
5264:             SET_EXPR_LOCATION (expr, rexpr_location (pred));
5265:           else_ = shortcut_cond_expr (expr, condition_uid);
5266:           else_se = else_ && TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (else_);
5267:           pred = TREE_OPERAND (pred, 0);
5268:           expr = build3 (COND_EXPR, void_type_node, pred, NULL_TREE, else_);
5269:           SET_EXPR_LOCATION (expr, locus);
5270:         }
5271:     }
5272:
5273:   /* The expr tree should also have the expression id set.  */
5274:   tree_associate_condition_with_expr (expr, condition_uid);
5275:
5276:   /* If we're done, great.  */
5277:   if (TREE_CODE (pred) != TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR
5278:       && TREE_CODE (pred) != TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5279:     return expr;
5280:
5281:   /* Otherwise we need to mess with gotos.  Change
5282:        if (a) c; else d;
5283:      to
5284:        if (a); else goto no;
5285:        c; goto end;
5286:        no: d; end:
5287:      and recursively gimplify the condition.  */
5288:
5289:   true_label = false_label = end_label = NULL_TREE;
5290:
5291:   /* If our arms just jump somewhere, hijack those labels so we don't
5292:      generate jumps to jumps.  */
5293:
5294:   if (tree then_goto = find_goto_label (then_))
5295:     {
5296:       true_label = GOTO_DESTINATION (then_goto);
5297:       then_ = NULL;
5298:       then_se = false;
5299:     }
5300:
5301:   if (tree else_goto = find_goto_label (else_))
5302:     {
5303:       false_label = GOTO_DESTINATION (else_goto);
5304:       else_ = NULL;
5305:       else_se = false;
5306:     }
5307:
5308:   /* If we aren't hijacking a label for the 'then' branch, it falls through.  */
5309:   if (true_label)
5310:     true_label_p = &true_label;
5311:   else
5312:     true_label_p = NULL;
5313:
5314:   /* The 'else' branch also needs a label if it contains interesting code.  */
5315:   if (false_label || else_se)
5316:     false_label_p = &false_label;
5317:   else
5318:     false_label_p = NULL;
5319:
5320:   /* If there was nothing else in our arms, just forward the label(s).  */
5321:   if (!then_se && !else_se)
5322:     return shortcut_cond_r (pred, true_label_p, false_label_p,
5323:                             EXPR_LOC_OR_LOC (expr, input_location), condition_uid);
5324:
5325:   /* If our last subexpression already has a terminal label, reuse it.  */
5326:   if (else_se)
5327:     t = expr_last (else_);
5328:   else if (then_se)
5329:     t = expr_last (then_);
5330:   else
5331:     t = NULL;
5332:   if (t && TREE_CODE (t) == LABEL_EXPR)
5333:     end_label = LABEL_EXPR_LABEL (t);
5334:
5335:   /* If we don't care about jumping to the 'else' branch, jump to the end
5336:      if the condition is false.  */
5337:   if (!false_label_p)
5338:     false_label_p = &end_label;
5339:
5340:   /* We only want to emit these labels if we aren't hijacking them.  */
5341:   emit_end = (end_label == NULL_TREE);
5342:   emit_false = (false_label == NULL_TREE);
5343:
5344:   /* We only emit the jump over the else clause if we have to--if the
5345:      then clause may fall through.  Otherwise we can wind up with a
5346:      useless jump and a useless label at the end of gimplified code,
5347:      which will cause us to think that this conditional as a whole
5348:      falls through even if it doesn't.  If we then inline a function
5349:      which ends with such a condition, that can cause us to issue an
5350:      inappropriate warning about control reaching the end of a
5351:      non-void function.  */
5352:   jump_over_else = block_may_fallthru (then_);
5353:
5354:   pred = shortcut_cond_r (pred, true_label_p, false_label_p,
5355:                           EXPR_LOC_OR_LOC (expr, input_location),
5356:                           condition_uid);
5357:
5358:   expr = NULL;
5359:   append_to_statement_list (pred, &expr);
5360:
5361:   append_to_statement_list (then_, &expr);
5362:   if (else_se)
5363:     {
5364:       if (jump_over_else)
5365:         {
5366:           tree last = expr_last (expr);
5367:           t = build_and_jump (&end_label);
5368:           if (rexpr_has_location (last))
5369:             SET_EXPR_LOCATION (t, rexpr_location (last));
5370:           append_to_statement_list (t, &expr);
5371:         }
5372:       if (emit_false)
5373:         {
5374:           t = build1 (LABEL_EXPR, void_type_node, false_label);
5375:           append_to_statement_list (t, &expr);
5376:         }
5377:       append_to_statement_list (else_, &expr);
5378:     }
5379:   if (emit_end && end_label)
5380:     {
5381:       t = build1 (LABEL_EXPR, void_type_node, end_label);
5382:       append_to_statement_list (t, &expr);
5383:     }
5384:
5385:   return expr;
5386: }
5387:
5388: /* EXPR is used in a boolean context; make sure it has BOOLEAN_TYPE.  */
5389:
5390: tree
5391: gimple_boolify (tree expr)
5392: {
5393:   tree type = TREE_TYPE (expr);
5394:   location_t loc = EXPR_LOCATION (expr);
5395:
5396:   if (TREE_CODE (expr) == NE_EXPR
5397:       && TREE_CODE (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0)) == CALL_EXPR
5398:       && integer_zerop (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1)))
5399:     {
5400:       tree call = TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0);
5401:       tree fn = get_callee_fndecl (call);
5402:
5403:       /* For __builtin_expect ((long) (x), y) recurse into x as well
5404:          if x is truth_value_p.  */
5405:       if (fn
5406:           && fndecl_built_in_p (fn, BUILT_IN_EXPECT)
5407:           && call_expr_nargs (call) == 2)
5408:         {
5409:           tree arg = CALL_EXPR_ARG (call, 0);
5410:           if (arg)
5411:             {
5412:               if (TREE_CODE (arg) == NOP_EXPR
5413:                   && TREE_TYPE (arg) == TREE_TYPE (call))
5414:                 arg = TREE_OPERAND (arg, 0);
5415:               if (truth_value_p (TREE_CODE (arg)))
5416:                 {
5417:                   arg = gimple_boolify (arg);
5418:                   CALL_EXPR_ARG (call, 0)
5419:                     = fold_convert_loc (loc, TREE_TYPE (call), arg);
5420:                 }
5421:             }
5422:         }
5423:     }
5424:
5425:   switch (TREE_CODE (expr))
5426:     {
5427:     case TRUTH_AND_EXPR:
5428:     case TRUTH_OR_EXPR:
5429:     case TRUTH_XOR_EXPR:
5430:     case TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR:
5431:     case TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR:
5432:       /* Also boolify the arguments of truth exprs.  */
5433:       TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1) = gimple_boolify (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1));
5434:       /* FALLTHRU */
5435:
5436:     case TRUTH_NOT_EXPR:
5437:       TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0) = gimple_boolify (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0));
5438:
5439:       /* These expressions always produce boolean results.  */
5440:       if (TREE_CODE (type) != BOOLEAN_TYPE)
5441:         TREE_TYPE (expr) = boolean_type_node;
5442:       return expr;
5443:
5444:     case ANNOTATE_EXPR:
5445:       switch ((enum annot_expr_kind) TREE_INT_CST_LOW (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1)))
5446:         {
5447:         case annot_expr_ivdep_kind:
5448:         case annot_expr_unroll_kind:
5449:         case annot_expr_no_vector_kind:
5450:         case annot_expr_vector_kind:
5451:         case annot_expr_parallel_kind:
5452:         case annot_expr_maybe_infinite_kind:
5453:           TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0) = gimple_boolify (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0));
5454:           if (TREE_CODE (type) != BOOLEAN_TYPE)
5455:             TREE_TYPE (expr) = boolean_type_node;
5456:           return expr;
5457:         default:
5458:           gcc_unreachable ();
5459:         }
5460:
5461:     default:
5462:       if (COMPARISON_CLASS_P (expr))
5463:         {
5464:           /* These expressions always produce boolean results.  */
5465:           if (TREE_CODE (type) != BOOLEAN_TYPE)
5466:             TREE_TYPE (expr) = boolean_type_node;
5467:           return expr;
5468:         }
5469:       /* Other expressions that get here must have boolean values, but
5470:          might need to be converted to the appropriate mode.  */
5471:       if (TREE_CODE (type) == BOOLEAN_TYPE)
5472:         return expr;
5473:       return fold_convert_loc (loc, boolean_type_node, expr);
5474:     }
5475: }
5476:
5477: /* Given a conditional expression *EXPR_P without side effects, gimplify
5478:    its operands.  New statements are inserted to PRE_P.  */
5479:
5480: static enum gimplify_status
5481: gimplify_pure_cond_expr (tree *expr_p, gimple_seq *pre_p)
5482: {
5483:   tree expr = *expr_p, cond;
5484:   enum gimplify_status ret, tret;
5485:   enum tree_code code;
5486:
5487:   cond = gimple_boolify (COND_EXPR_COND (expr));
5488:
5489:   /* We need to handle && and || specially, as their gimplification
5490:      creates pure cond_expr, thus leading to an infinite cycle otherwise.  */
5491:   code = TREE_CODE (cond);
5492:   if (code == TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR)
5493:     TREE_SET_CODE (cond, TRUTH_AND_EXPR);
5494:   else if (code == TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5495:     TREE_SET_CODE (cond, TRUTH_OR_EXPR);
5496:   ret = gimplify_expr (&cond, pre_p, NULL, is_gimple_val, fb_rvalue);
5497:   COND_EXPR_COND (*expr_p) = cond;
5498:
5499:   tret = gimplify_expr (&COND_EXPR_THEN (expr), pre_p, NULL,
5500:                         is_gimple_val, fb_rvalue);
5501:   ret = MIN (ret, tret);
5502:   tret = gimplify_expr (&COND_EXPR_ELSE (expr), pre_p, NULL,
5503:                         is_gimple_val, fb_rvalue);
5504:
5505:   return MIN (ret, tret);
5506: }
5507:
5508: /* Return true if evaluating EXPR could trap.
5509:    EXPR is GENERIC, while tree_could_trap_p can be called
5510:    only on GIMPLE.  */
5511:
5512: bool
5513: generic_expr_could_trap_p (tree expr)
5514: {
5515:   unsigned i, n;
5516:
5517:   if (!expr || is_gimple_val (expr))
5518:     return false;
5519:
5520:   if (!EXPR_P (expr) || tree_could_trap_p (expr))
5521:     return true;
5522:
5523:   n = TREE_OPERAND_LENGTH (expr);
5524:   for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
5525:     if (generic_expr_could_trap_p (TREE_OPERAND (expr, i)))
5526:       return true;
5527:
5528:   return false;
5529: }
5530:
5531: /* Associate the condition STMT with the discriminator UID.  STMTs that are
5532:    broken down with ANDIF/ORIF from the same Boolean expression should be given
5533:    the same UID; 'if (a && b && c) { if (d || e) ... } ...' should yield the
5534:    { a: 1, b: 1, c: 1, d: 2, e: 2 } when gimplification is done.  This is used
5535:    for condition coverage.  */
5536: static void
5537: gimple_associate_condition_with_expr (struct function *fn, gcond *stmt,
5538:                                       unsigned uid)
5539: {
5540:   if (!condition_coverage_flag)
5541:     return;
5542:
5543:   if (!fn->cond_uids)
5544:     fn->cond_uids = new hash_map <gcond*, unsigned> ();
5545:
5546:   fn->cond_uids->put (stmt, uid);
5547: }
5548:
5549: /*  Convert the conditional expression pointed to by EXPR_P '(p) ? a : b;'
5550:     into
5551:
5552:     if (p)                      if (p)
5553:       t1 = a;                     a;
5554:     else                or      else
5555:       t1 = b;                     b;
5556:     t1;
5557:
5558:     The second form is used when *EXPR_P is of type void.
5559:
5560:     PRE_P points to the list where side effects that must happen before
5561:       *EXPR_P should be stored.  */
5562:
5563: static enum gimplify_status
5564: gimplify_cond_expr (tree *expr_p, gimple_seq *pre_p, fallback_t fallback)
5565: {
5566:   tree expr = *expr_p;
5567:   tree type = TREE_TYPE (expr);
5568:   location_t loc = EXPR_LOCATION (expr);
5569:   tree tmp, arm1, arm2;
5570:   enum gimplify_status ret;
5571:   tree label_true, label_false, label_cont;
5572:   bool have_then_clause_p, have_else_clause_p;
5573:   gcond *cond_stmt;
5574:   enum tree_code pred_code;
5575:   gimple_seq seq = NULL;
5576:
5577:   /* If this COND_EXPR has a value, copy the values into a temporary within
5578:      the arms.  */
5579:   if (!VOID_TYPE_P (type))
5580:     {
5581:       tree then_ = TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1), else_ = TREE_OPERAND (expr, 2);
5582:       tree result;
5583:
5584:       /* If either an rvalue is ok or we do not require an lvalue, create the
5585:          temporary.  But we cannot do that if the type is addressable.  */
5586:       if (((fallback & fb_rvalue) || !(fallback & fb_lvalue))
5587:           && !TREE_ADDRESSABLE (type))
5588:         {
5589:           if (gimplify_ctxp->allow_rhs_cond_expr
5590:               /* If either branch has side effects or could trap, it can't be
5591:                  evaluated unconditionally.  */
5592:               && !TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (then_)
5593:               && !generic_expr_could_trap_p (then_)
5594:               && !TREE_SIDE_EFFECTS (else_)
5595:               && !generic_expr_could_trap_p (else_))
5596:             return gimplify_pure_cond_expr (expr_p, pre_p);
5597:
5598:           tmp = create_tmp_var (type, "iftmp");
5599:           result = tmp;
5600:         }
5601:
5602:       /* Otherwise, only create and copy references to the values.  */
5603:       else
5604:         {
5605:           type = build_pointer_type (type);
5606:
5607:           if (!VOID_TYPE_P (TREE_TYPE (then_)))
5608:             then_ = build_fold_addr_expr_loc (loc, then_);
5609:
5610:           if (!VOID_TYPE_P (TREE_TYPE (else_)))
5611:             else_ = build_fold_addr_expr_loc (loc, else_);
5612:
5613:           expr
5614:             = build3 (COND_EXPR, type, TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0), then_, else_);
5615:
5616:           tmp = create_tmp_var (type, "iftmp");
5617:           result = build_simple_mem_ref_loc (loc, tmp);
5618:         }
5619:
5620:       /* Build the new then clause, `tmp = then_;'.  But don't build the
5621:          assignment if the value is void; in C++ it can be if it's a throw.  */
5622:       if (!VOID_TYPE_P (TREE_TYPE (then_)))
5623:         TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1) = build2 (INIT_EXPR, type, tmp, then_);
5624:
5625:       /* Similarly, build the new else clause, `tmp = else_;'.  */
5626:       if (!VOID_TYPE_P (TREE_TYPE (else_)))
5627:         TREE_OPERAND (expr, 2) = build2 (INIT_EXPR, type, tmp, else_);
5628:
5629:       TREE_TYPE (expr) = void_type_node;
5630:       recalculate_side_effects (expr);
5631:
5632:       /* Move the COND_EXPR to the prequeue.  */
5633:       gimplify_stmt (&expr, pre_p);
5634:
5635:       *expr_p = result;
5636:       return GS_ALL_DONE;
5637:     }
5638:
5639:   /* Remove any COMPOUND_EXPR so the following cases will be caught.  */
5640:   STRIP_TYPE_NOPS (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0));
5641:   if (TREE_CODE (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0)) == COMPOUND_EXPR)
5642:     gimplify_compound_expr (&TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0), pre_p, true);
5643:
5644:   /* Make sure the condition has BOOLEAN_TYPE.  */
5645:   TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0) = gimple_boolify (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0));
5646:
5647:   /* Break apart && and || conditions.  */
5648:   if (TREE_CODE (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0)) == TRUTH_ANDIF_EXPR
5649:       || TREE_CODE (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0)) == TRUTH_ORIF_EXPR)
5650:     {
5651:       expr = shortcut_cond_expr (expr, next_cond_uid ());
5652:
5653:       if (expr != *expr_p)
5654:         {
5655:           *expr_p = expr;
5656:
5657:           /* We can't rely on gimplify_expr to re-gimplify the expanded
5658:              form properly, as cleanups might cause the target labels to be
5659:              wrapped in a TRY_FINALLY_EXPR.  To prevent that, we need to
5660:              set up a conditional context.  */
5661:           gimple_push_condition ();
5662:           gimplify_stmt (expr_p, &seq);
5663:           gimple_pop_condition (pre_p);
5664:           gimple_seq_add_seq (pre_p, seq);
5665:
5666:           return GS_ALL_DONE;
5667:         }
5668:     }
5669:
5670:   /* Now do the normal gimplification.  */
5671:
5672:   /* Gimplify condition.  */
5673:   ret = gimplify_expr (&TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0), pre_p, NULL,
5674:                        is_gimple_condexpr_for_cond, fb_rvalue);
5675:   if (ret == GS_ERROR)
5676:     return GS_ERROR;
5677:   gcc_assert (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 0) != NULL_TREE);
5678:
5679:   gimple_push_condition ();
5680:
5681:   have_then_clause_p = have_else_clause_p = false;
5682:   label_true = find_goto_label (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 1));
5683:   if (label_true
5684:       && DECL_CONTEXT (GOTO_DESTINATION (label_true)) == current_function_decl
5685:       /* For -O0 avoid this optimization if the COND_EXPR and GOTO_EXPR
5686:          have different locations, otherwise we end up with incorrect
5687:          location information on the branches.  */
5688:       && (optimize
5689:           || !EXPR_HAS_LOCATION (expr)
5690:           || !rexpr_has_location (label_true)
5691:           || EXPR_LOCATION (expr) == rexpr_location (label_true)))
5692:     {
5693:       have_then_clause_p = true;
5694:       label_true = GOTO_DESTINATION (label_true);
5695:     }
5696:   else
5697:     label_true = create_artificial_label (UNKNOWN_LOCATION);
5698:   label_false = find_goto_label (TREE_OPERAND (expr, 2));
5699:   if (label_false
5700:       && DECL_CONTEXT (GOTO_DESTINATION (label_false)) == current_function_decl
5701:       /* For -O0 avoid this optimization if the COND_EXPR and GOTO_EXPR
5702:          have different locations, otherwise we end up with incorrect
5703:          location information on the branches.  */
5704:       && (optimize
5705:           || !EXPR_HAS_LOCATION (expr)
5706:           || !rexpr_has_location (label_false)
5707:           || EXPR_LOCATION (expr) == rexpr_location (label_false)))
5708:     {
5709:       have_else_clause_p = true;
5710:       label_false = GOTO_DESTINATION (label_false);
5711:     }
5712:   else
5713:     label_false = create_artificial_label (UNKNOWN_LOCATION);
5714:
```

```text
7628:
7629: static enum gimplify_status
7630: gimplify_variable_sized_compare (tree *expr_p)
7631: {
7632:   location_t loc = EXPR_LOCATION (*expr_p);
7633:   tree op0 = TREE_OPERAND (*expr_p, 0);
7634:   tree op1 = TREE_OPERAND (*expr_p, 1);
7635:   tree t, arg, dest, src, expr;
7636:
7637:   arg = TYPE_SIZE_UNIT (TREE_TYPE (op0));
7638:   arg = unshare_expr (arg);
7639:   arg = SUBSTITUTE_PLACEHOLDER_IN_EXPR (arg, op0);
7640:   src = build_fold_addr_expr_loc (loc, op1);
7641:   dest = build_fold_addr_expr_loc (loc, op0);
7642:   t = builtin_decl_implicit (BUILT_IN_MEMCMP);
7643:   t = build_call_expr_loc (loc, t, 3, dest, src, arg);
7644:
7645:   expr
7646:     = build2 (TREE_CODE (*expr_p), TREE_TYPE (*expr_p), t, integer_zero_node);
7647:   SET_EXPR_LOCATION (expr, loc);
7648:   *expr_p = expr;

7650:   return GS_OK;
7651: }
7652:
7653: /* Gimplify a comparison between two aggregate objects of integral scalar
7654:    mode as a comparison between the bitwise equivalent scalar values.  */
7655:
7656: static enum gimplify_status
7657: gimplify_scalar_mode_aggregate_compare (tree *expr_p)
7658: {
7659:   const location_t loc = EXPR_LOCATION (*expr_p);
7660:   const enum tree_code code = TREE_CODE (*expr_p);
7661:   tree op0 = TREE_OPERAND (*expr_p, 0);
7662:   tree op1 = TREE_OPERAND (*expr_p, 1);
7663:   tree type = TREE_TYPE (op0);
7664:   tree scalar_type = lang_hooks.types.type_for_mode (TYPE_MODE (type), 1);
7665:
7666:   op0 = fold_build1_loc (loc, VIEW_CONVERT_EXPR, scalar_type, op0);
7667:   op1 = fold_build1_loc (loc, VIEW_CONVERT_EXPR, scalar_type, op1);
7668:
7669:   /* We need to perform ordering comparisons in memory order like memcmp and,
7670:      therefore, may need to byte-swap operands for little-endian targets.  */
7671:   if (code != EQ_EXPR && code != NE_EXPR)
7672:     {
7673:       gcc_assert (BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN == WORDS_BIG_ENDIAN);
7674:       gcc_assert (TREE_CODE (scalar_type) == INTEGER_TYPE);
7675:       tree fndecl;
7676:
7677:       if (BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN)
7678:         fndecl = NULL_TREE;
7679:       else
7680:         switch (int_size_in_bytes (scalar_type))
7681:           {
7682:           case 1:
7683:             fndecl = NULL_TREE;
7684:             break;
7685:           case 2:
7686:             fndecl = builtin_decl_implicit (BUILT_IN_BSWAP16);
7687:             break;
7688:           case 4:
7689:             fndecl = builtin_decl_implicit (BUILT_IN_BSWAP32);
7690:             break;
7691:           case 8:
7692:             fndecl = builtin_decl_implicit (BUILT_IN_BSWAP64);
7693:             break;
7694:           case 16:
7695:             fndecl = builtin_decl_implicit (BUILT_IN_BSWAP128);
7696:             break;
7697:           default:
7698:             gcc_unreachable ();
7699:           }
7700:
7701:       if (fndecl)
7702:         {
7703:           op0 = build_call_expr_loc (loc, fndecl, 1, op0);
7704:           op1 = build_call_expr_loc (loc, fndecl, 1, op1);
7705:         }
7706:     }
7707:
7708:   *expr_p = fold_build2_loc (loc, code, TREE_TYPE (*expr_p), op0, op1);
7709:
7710:   return GS_OK;
```

```text
174: /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------
175:                               Create basic blocks
176: ---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
177:
178: /* Entry point to the CFG builder for trees.  SEQ is the sequence of
179:    statements to be added to the flowgraph.  */
180:
181: static void
182: build_gimple_cfg (gimple_seq seq)
183: {
184:   /* Register specific gimple functions.  */
185:   gimple_register_cfg_hooks ();
186:
187:   memset ((void *) &cfg_stats, 0, sizeof (cfg_stats));
188:
189:   init_empty_tree_cfg ();
190:
191:   make_blocks (seq);
192:
193:   /* Make sure there is always at least one block, even if it's empty.  */
194:   if (n_basic_blocks_for_fn (cfun) == NUM_FIXED_BLOCKS)
195:     create_empty_bb (ENTRY_BLOCK_PTR_FOR_FN (cfun));
196:
197:   /* Adjust the size of the array.  */
198:   if (basic_block_info_for_fn (cfun)->length ()
199:       < (size_t) n_basic_blocks_for_fn (cfun))
200:     vec_safe_grow_cleared (basic_block_info_for_fn (cfun),
201:                            n_basic_blocks_for_fn (cfun));
202:
203:   /* To speed up statement iterator walks, we first purge dead labels.  */
204:   cleanup_dead_labels ();
205:
206:   /* Group case nodes to reduce the number of edges.
207:      We do this after cleaning up dead labels because otherwise we miss
208:      a lot of obvious case merging opportunities.  */
209:   group_case_labels ();
210:
211:   /* Create the edges of the flowgraph.  */
212:   make_edges ();
213:   assign_discriminators ();
214:   cleanup_dead_labels ();
215: }
```

```text
488: make_blocks_1 (gimple_seq seq, basic_block bb)
489: {
490:   gimple_stmt_iterator i = gsi_start (seq);
491:   gimple *stmt = NULL;
492:   gimple *prev_stmt = NULL;
493:   bool start_new_block = true;
494:   bool first_stmt_of_seq = true;
495:
496:   while (!gsi_end_p (i))
497:     {
498:       /* PREV_STMT should only be set to a debug stmt if the debug
499:          stmt is before nondebug stmts.  Once stmt reaches a nondebug
500:          nonlabel, prev_stmt will be set to it, so that
501:          stmt_starts_bb_p will know to start a new block if a label is
502:          found.  However, if stmt was a label after debug stmts only,
503:          keep the label in prev_stmt even if we find further debug
504:          stmts, for there may be other labels after them, and they
505:          should land in the same block.  */
506:       if (!prev_stmt || !stmt || !is_gimple_debug (stmt))
507:         prev_stmt = stmt;
508:       stmt = gsi_stmt (i);
509:
510:       if (stmt && is_gimple_call (stmt))
511:         gimple_call_initialize_ctrl_altering (stmt);
512:
513:       /* If the statement starts a new basic block or if we have determined
514:          in a previous pass that we need to create a new block for STMT, do
515:          so now.  */
516:       if (start_new_block || stmt_starts_bb_p (stmt, prev_stmt))
517:         {
518:           if (!first_stmt_of_seq)
519:             gsi_split_seq_before (&i, &seq);
520:           bb = create_basic_block (seq, bb);
521:           start_new_block = false;
522:           prev_stmt = NULL;
523:         }
524:
525:       /* Now add STMT to BB and create the subgraphs for special statement
526:          codes.  */
527:       gimple_set_bb (stmt, bb);
528:
529:       /* If STMT is a basic block terminator, set START_NEW_BLOCK for the
530:          next iteration.  */
531:       if (stmt_ends_bb_p (stmt))
532:         {
533:           /* If the stmt can make abnormal goto use a new temporary
534:              for the assignment to the LHS.  This makes sure the old value
535:              of the LHS is available on the abnormal edge.  Otherwise
536:              we will end up with overlapping life-ranges for abnormal
537:              SSA names.  */
538:           if (gimple_has_lhs (stmt)
539:               && stmt_can_make_abnormal_goto (stmt)
540:               && is_gimple_reg_type (TREE_TYPE (gimple_get_lhs (stmt))))
541:             {
542:               tree lhs = gimple_get_lhs (stmt);
543:               tree tmp = create_tmp_var (TREE_TYPE (lhs));
544:               gimple *s = gimple_build_assign (lhs, tmp);
545:               gimple_set_location (s, gimple_location (stmt));
546:               gimple_set_block (s, gimple_block (stmt));
547:               gimple_set_lhs (stmt, tmp);
548:               gsi_insert_after (&i, s, GSI_SAME_STMT);
549:             }
550:           start_new_block = true;
551:         }
552:
553:       gsi_next (&i);
554:       first_stmt_of_seq = false;
555:     }
```

```text
1371: make_goto_expr_edges (basic_block bb)
```

```text
1520:         {

1523:

1530:              remember this one and see if there are more labels.  */
1531:           if (!label_for_bb[bb->index].label)

1540:           if (!DECL_ARTIFICIAL (label)
```

```text
203: static void
204: record_in_finally_tree (treemple child, gtry *parent)
205: {
206:   struct finally_tree_node *n;
207:   finally_tree_node **slot;
208:
209:   n = XNEW (struct finally_tree_node);
210:   n->child = child;
211:   n->parent = parent;
212:
213:   slot = finally_tree->find_slot (n, INSERT);
214:   gcc_assert (!*slot);
215:   *slot = n;
216: }
217:
218: static void
219: collect_finally_tree (gimple *stmt, gtry *region);
220:
221: /* Go through the gimple sequence.  Works with collect_finally_tree to
222:    record all GIMPLE_LABEL and GIMPLE_TRY statements. */
223:
224: static void
225: collect_finally_tree_1 (gimple_seq seq, gtry *region)
226: {
227:   gimple_stmt_iterator gsi;
228:
229:   for (gsi = gsi_start (seq); !gsi_end_p (gsi); gsi_next (&gsi))
230:     collect_finally_tree (gsi_stmt (gsi), region);
231: }
232:
233: static void
234: collect_finally_tree (gimple *stmt, gtry *region)
235: {
236:   treemple temp;
237:
238:   switch (gimple_code (stmt))
239:     {
240:     case GIMPLE_LABEL:
241:       temp.t = gimple_label_label (as_a <glabel *> (stmt));
242:       record_in_finally_tree (temp, region);
243:       break;
244:
245:     case GIMPLE_TRY:
246:       if (gimple_try_kind (stmt) == GIMPLE_TRY_FINALLY)
247:         {
248:           temp.g = stmt;
249:           record_in_finally_tree (temp, region);
250:           collect_finally_tree_1 (gimple_try_eval (stmt),
251:                                   as_a <gtry *> (stmt));
```

```text
871: cleanup_tree_cfg_bb (basic_block bb)
872: {
873:   if (maybe_remove_forwarder_block (bb))
874:     return true;
875:
876:   /* If there is a merge opportunity with the predecessor
877:      do nothing now but wait until we process the predecessor.
878:      This happens when we visit BBs in a non-optimal order and
879:      avoids quadratic behavior with adjusting stmts BB pointer.  */
880:   if (single_pred_p (bb)
881:       && want_merge_blocks_p (single_pred (bb), bb))
882:     /* But make sure we _do_ visit it.  When we remove unreachable paths
883:        ending in a backedge we fail to mark the destinations predecessors
884:        as changed.  */
885:     bitmap_set_bit (cfgcleanup_altered_bbs, single_pred (bb)->index);
886:
887:   /* Merging the blocks may create new opportunities for folding
888:      conditional branches (due to the elimination of single-valued PHI
889:      nodes).  */
890:   else if (single_succ_p (bb)
891:            && want_merge_blocks_p (bb, single_succ (bb)))
892:     {
893:       merge_blocks (bb, single_succ (bb));

895:     }
896:
897:   return false;
```

```text
240:                            void_type_node);
241:   DECL_ARTIFICIAL (global_var) = 1;
242:   DECL_IGNORED_P (global_var) = 1;
243:   TREE_READONLY (global_var) = 0;
244:   DECL_EXTERNAL (global_var) = 1;
245:   TREE_STATIC (global_var) = 1;
246:   TREE_USED (global_var) = 1;
247:   DECL_CONTEXT (global_var) = NULL_TREE;
248:   TREE_THIS_VOLATILE (global_var) = 0;
249:   TREE_ADDRESSABLE (global_var) = 0;
250:   VAR_DECL_IS_VIRTUAL_OPERAND (global_var) = 1;
251:
252:   fn->gimple_df->vop = global_var;
253: }
254:
255: /* These are the sizes of the operand memory buffer in bytes which gets
256:    allocated each time more operands space is required.  The final value is
257:    the amount that is allocated every time after that.
258:    In 1k we can fit 25 use operands (or 63 def operands) on a host with
259:    8 byte pointers, that would be 10 statements each with 1 def and 2
260:    uses.  */
261:
262: #define OP_SIZE_INIT    0
263: #define OP_SIZE_1       (1024 - sizeof (void *))
264: #define OP_SIZE_2       (1024 * 4 - sizeof (void *))
265: #define OP_SIZE_3       (1024 * 16 - sizeof (void *))
266:
267: /* Initialize the operand cache routines.  */
268:
269: void
270: init_ssa_operands (struct function *fn)
271: {
272:   gcc_assert (gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->operand_memory == NULL);
273:   gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->operand_memory_index
274:      = gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->ssa_operand_mem_size;
275:   gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->ops_active = true;
276:   gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->ssa_operand_mem_size = OP_SIZE_INIT;
277:   create_vop_var (fn);
278: }
```

```text
424: /* Takes elements from build_uses and turns them into use operands of STMT.  */
425:
426: inline void
427: operands_scanner::finalize_ssa_uses ()
428: {
429:   unsigned new_i;
430:   struct use_optype_d new_list;
431:   use_optype_p old_ops, ptr, last;
432:
433:   /* Pre-pend the VUSE we may have built.  */
434:   if (build_vuse != NULL_TREE)
435:     {
436:       tree oldvuse = gimple_vuse (stmt);
437:       if (oldvuse
438:           && TREE_CODE (oldvuse) == SSA_NAME)
439:         oldvuse = SSA_NAME_VAR (oldvuse);
440:       if (oldvuse != (build_vuse != NULL_TREE
441:                       ? build_vuse : build_vdef))
442:         gimple_set_vuse (stmt, NULL_TREE);
443:       build_uses.safe_insert (0, gimple_vuse_ptr (stmt));
444:     }
445:
446:   new_list.next = NULL;
447:   last = &new_list;
448:
449:   old_ops = gimple_use_ops (stmt);
450:
451:   /* Clear a no longer necessary VUSE.  */
452:   if (build_vuse == NULL_TREE
453:       && gimple_vuse (stmt) != NULL_TREE)
454:     gimple_set_vuse (stmt, NULL_TREE);
455:
456:   /* If there is anything in the old list, free it.  */
457:   if (old_ops)
458:     {
459:       for (ptr = old_ops; ptr->next; ptr = ptr->next)
460:         delink_imm_use (USE_OP_PTR (ptr));
461:       delink_imm_use (USE_OP_PTR (ptr));
462:       ptr->next = gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->free_uses;
463:       gimple_ssa_operands (fn)->free_uses = old_ops;
464:     }
465:
466:   /* If we added a VUSE, make sure to set the operand if it is not already
467:      present and mark it for renaming.  */
468:   if (build_vuse != NULL_TREE
469:       && gimple_vuse (stmt) == NULL_TREE)
470:     {
471:       gimple_set_vuse (stmt, gimple_vop (fn));
472:       fn->gimple_df->rename_vops = 1;
473:       fn->gimple_df->ssa_renaming_needed = 1;
474:     }
475:
476:   /* Now create nodes for all the new nodes.  */
477:   for (new_i = 0; new_i < build_uses.length (); new_i++)
478:     {
479:       tree *op = build_uses[new_i];
480:       last = add_use_op (fn, stmt, op, last);
481:     }
482:
483:   /* Now set the stmt's operands.  */
484:   gimple_set_use_ops (stmt, new_list.next);
485: }
```

## gcc/tree-ssa-operands.cc:951–995

```text
951: void
952: operands_scanner::parse_ssa_operands ()
953: {
954:   enum gimple_code code = gimple_code (stmt);
955:   size_t i, n, start = 0;
956:
957:   switch (code)
958:     {
959:     case GIMPLE_ASM:
960:       get_asm_stmt_operands (as_a <gasm *> (stmt));
961:       break;
962:
963:     case GIMPLE_TRANSACTION:
964:       /* The start of a transaction is a memory barrier.  */
965:       add_virtual_operand (opf_def | opf_use);
966:       break;
967:
968:     case GIMPLE_DEBUG:
969:       if (gimple_debug_bind_p (stmt)
970:           && gimple_debug_bind_has_value_p (stmt))
971:         get_expr_operands (gimple_debug_bind_get_value_ptr (stmt),
972:                            opf_use | opf_no_vops);
973:       break;
974:
975:     case GIMPLE_RETURN:
976:       append_vuse (gimple_vop (fn));
977:       goto do_default;
978:
979:     case GIMPLE_CALL:
980:       /* Add call-clobbered operands, if needed.  */
981:       maybe_add_call_vops (as_a <gcall *> (stmt));
982:       /* FALLTHRU */
983:
984:     case GIMPLE_ASSIGN:
985:       get_expr_operands (gimple_op_ptr (stmt, 0), opf_def);
986:       start = 1;
987:       /* FALLTHRU */
988:
989:     default:
990:     do_default:
991:       n = gimple_num_ops (stmt);
992:       for (i = start; i < n; i++)
993:         get_expr_operands (gimple_op_ptr (stmt, i), opf_use);
994:       break;
995:     }
```

```text
648: mark_def_sites (basic_block bb, gimple *stmt, bitmap kills)
649: {
650:   tree def;
651:   use_operand_p use_p;
652:   ssa_op_iter iter;
653:
654:   /* Since this is the first time that we rewrite the program into SSA
655:      form, force an operand scan on every statement.  */
656:   update_stmt (stmt);
657:
658:   gcc_checking_assert (blocks_to_update == NULL);
659:   set_register_defs (stmt, false);
660:   set_rewrite_uses (stmt, false);
661:
662:   if (is_gimple_debug (stmt))
663:     {
664:       FOR_EACH_SSA_USE_OPERAND (use_p, stmt, iter, SSA_OP_USE)
665:         {
666:           tree sym = USE_FROM_PTR (use_p);
667:           gcc_checking_assert (DECL_P (sym));
668:           set_rewrite_uses (stmt, true);
669:         }
670:       if (rewrite_uses_p (stmt))
671:         bitmap_set_bit (interesting_blocks, bb->index);
672:       return;
673:     }
674:
675:   /* If a variable is used before being set, then the variable is live
676:      across a block boundary, so mark it live-on-entry to BB.  */
677:   FOR_EACH_SSA_USE_OPERAND (use_p, stmt, iter, SSA_OP_ALL_USES)
678:     {
679:       tree sym = USE_FROM_PTR (use_p);
680:       if (TREE_CODE (sym) == SSA_NAME)
681:         continue;
682:       gcc_checking_assert (DECL_P (sym));
683:       if (!bitmap_bit_p (kills, DECL_UID (sym)))
684:         set_livein_block (sym, bb);
685:       set_rewrite_uses (stmt, true);
686:     }
687:
688:   /* Now process the defs.  Mark BB as the definition block and add
689:      each def to the set of killed symbols.  */
690:   FOR_EACH_SSA_TREE_OPERAND (def, stmt, iter, SSA_OP_ALL_DEFS)
691:     {
692:       if (TREE_CODE (def) == SSA_NAME)
693:         continue;
694:       gcc_checking_assert (DECL_P (def));
695:       set_def_block (def, bb, false);
696:       bitmap_set_bit (kills, DECL_UID (def));
697:       set_register_defs (stmt, true);
698:     }
699:
700:   /* If we found the statement interesting then also mark the block BB
701:      as interesting.  */
702:   if (rewrite_uses_p (stmt) || register_defs_p (stmt))
703:     bitmap_set_bit (interesting_blocks, bb->index);
704: }
```

```text
1337: rewrite_stmt (gimple_stmt_iterator *si)
1338: {
1339:   use_operand_p use_p;
1340:   def_operand_p def_p;
1341:   ssa_op_iter iter;
1342:   gimple *stmt = gsi_stmt (*si);
1343:
1344:   /* If mark_def_sites decided that we don't need to rewrite this
1345:      statement, ignore it.  */
1346:   gcc_assert (blocks_to_update == NULL);
1347:   if (!rewrite_uses_p (stmt) && !register_defs_p (stmt))
1348:     return;
1349:
1350:   if (dump_file && (dump_flags & TDF_DETAILS))
1351:     {
1352:       fprintf (dump_file, "Renaming statement ");
1353:       print_gimple_stmt (dump_file, stmt, 0, TDF_SLIM);
1354:       fprintf (dump_file, "\n");
1355:     }
1356:
1357:   /* Step 1.  Rewrite USES in the statement.  */
1358:   if (rewrite_uses_p (stmt))
1359:     {
1360:       if (is_gimple_debug (stmt))
1361:         rewrite_debug_stmt_uses (stmt);
1362:       else
1363:         FOR_EACH_SSA_USE_OPERAND (use_p, stmt, iter, SSA_OP_ALL_USES)
1364:           {
1365:             tree var = USE_FROM_PTR (use_p);
1366:             if (TREE_CODE (var) == SSA_NAME)
1367:               continue;
1368:             gcc_checking_assert (DECL_P (var));
1369:             SET_USE (use_p, get_reaching_def (var));
1370:           }
1371:     }
1372:
1373:   /* Step 2.  Register the statement's DEF operands.  */
1374:   if (register_defs_p (stmt))
1375:     FOR_EACH_SSA_DEF_OPERAND (def_p, stmt, iter, SSA_OP_ALL_DEFS)
1376:       {
1377:         tree var = DEF_FROM_PTR (def_p);
1378:         tree name;
1379:         tree tracked_var;
1380:
1381:         if (TREE_CODE (var) == SSA_NAME)
1382:           continue;
1383:         gcc_checking_assert (DECL_P (var));
1384:
1385:         if (gimple_clobber_p (stmt)
1386:             && is_gimple_reg (var))
1387:           {
1388:             /* If we rewrite a DECL into SSA form then drop its
1389:                clobber stmts and replace uses with a new default def.  */
1390:             gcc_checking_assert (VAR_P (var) && !gimple_vdef (stmt));
1391:             gsi_replace (si, gimple_build_nop (), true);
1392:             register_new_def (get_or_create_ssa_default_def (cfun, var), var);
1393:             break;
1394:           }
1395:
1396:         name = make_ssa_name (var, stmt);
1397:         SET_DEF (def_p, name);
1398:         register_new_def (DEF_FROM_PTR (def_p), var);
1399:
1400:         /* Do not insert debug stmts if the stmt ends the BB.  */
1401:         if (stmt_ends_bb_p (stmt))
1402:           continue;
1403:
1404:         tracked_var = target_for_debug_bind (var);
1405:         if (tracked_var)
1406:           {
1407:             gimple *note = gimple_build_debug_bind (tracked_var, name, stmt);
```

```text
2656: /* Called via walk_function+walk_gimple_stmt, rewrite all GIMPLE_GOTOs
2657:    that reference labels from outer functions.  The rewrite will be a
2658:    call to __builtin_nonlocal_goto.  */
2659:
2660: static tree
2661: convert_nl_goto_reference (gimple_stmt_iterator *gsi, bool *handled_ops_p,
2662:                            struct walk_stmt_info *wi)
2663: {
2664:   struct nesting_info *const info = (struct nesting_info *) wi->info, *i;
2665:   tree label, new_label, target_context, x, field;
2666:   gcall *call;
2667:   gimple *stmt = gsi_stmt (*gsi);
2668:
2669:   if (gimple_code (stmt) != GIMPLE_GOTO)
2670:     {
2671:       *handled_ops_p = false;
2672:       return NULL_TREE;
2673:     }
2674:
2675:   label = gimple_goto_dest (stmt);
2676:   if (TREE_CODE (label) != LABEL_DECL)
2677:     {
2678:       *handled_ops_p = false;
2679:       return NULL_TREE;
2680:     }
2681:
2682:   target_context = decl_function_context (label);
2683:   if (target_context == info->context)
2684:     {
2685:       *handled_ops_p = false;
2686:       return NULL_TREE;
2687:     }
2688:
2689:   for (i = info->outer; target_context != i->context; i = i->outer)
2690:     continue;
2691:
2692:   /* The original user label may also be use for a normal goto, therefore
2693:      we must create a new label that will actually receive the abnormal
2694:      control transfer.  This new label will be marked LABEL_NONLOCAL; this
2695:      mark will trigger proper behavior in the cfg, as well as cause the
2696:      (hairy target-specific) non-local goto receiver code to be generated
2697:      when we expand rtl.  Enter this association into var_map so that we
2698:      can insert the new label into the IL during a second pass.  */
2699:   tree *slot = &i->var_map->get_or_insert (label);
2700:   if (*slot == NULL)
2701:     {
2702:       new_label = create_artificial_label (UNKNOWN_LOCATION);
2703:       DECL_NONLOCAL (new_label) = 1;
2704:       DECL_CONTEXT (new_label) = target_context;
2705:       *slot = new_label;
2706:     }
2707:   else
2708:     new_label = *slot;
2709:
2710:   /* Build: __builtin_nl_goto(new_label, &chain->nl_goto_field).  */
2711:   field = get_nl_goto_field (i);
2712:   x = get_frame_field (info, target_context, field, gsi);
2713:   x = build_addr (x);
2714:   x = gsi_gimplify_val (info, x, gsi);
2715:   call = gimple_build_call (builtin_decl_implicit (BUILT_IN_NONLOCAL_GOTO),
2716:                             2, build_addr (new_label), x);
2717:   gsi_replace (gsi, call, false);
2718:
2719:   /* We have handled all of STMT's operands, no need to keep going.  */
```
